# InfoNavigator

> The independent, data-driven buying guide. We read thousands of public reviews and synthesize them into one 0-10 MetaScore per product, with the source count shown next to every score. Rankings are computed from public ratings data — never sponsored, always disclosed. Prices re-verified monthly.

## Start here

- [Best 3D Printer (2026): Data-Driven Rankings & Comparisons](https://infonavigator.org/3d-printers/): the hub — all 8 printers ranked with MetaScores
- [Best 3D printer for beginners](https://infonavigator.org/3d-printers/best-3d-printer-for-beginners/): first-printer picks, ranked by ease of use
- [Best budget 3D printer](https://infonavigator.org/3d-printers/best-budget-3d-printer/): best value under tight budgets
- [Best multicolor 3D printer](https://infonavigator.org/3d-printers/best-multicolor-3d-printer/): multi-material and multi-color systems compared
- [How we rate](https://infonavigator.org/how-we-rate/): the MetaScore methodology, published in full
- [Disclosure](https://infonavigator.org/disclosure/): how the site makes money (affiliate commissions; never influences rankings)

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices on this site are date-stamped; treat any price older than 30 days as stale.
- MetaScores are computed from public review data and re-scored when flagships launch or prices move materially.
- The Elegoo Centauri Carbon 2 score is provisional — owner review data is still thin.
- Bambu Lab has no public affiliate program; links for Bambu Lab printers go to retailers, not the manufacturer.
